'''Telgorn Corporation''' was the manufacturer of a number of [[Space station/Legends|space stations]] and a large line of small transports in addition to [[jolt cell]]s around the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. They produced things for both the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].

==Corporate links==
It is possible that [[Kost & Ko Factories]] entered a joint venture with the Telgorn Corporation over the design and manufacture of the [[Deep Space Manufacturing Facility|X7 Deep Space Manufacturing Facility]], or at least licensed the right to produce it to the larger company.

Furthermore, the similarity in design of the [[XQ Platform series]] indicates a strong degree of cooperation between Telgorn, [[Bengel Shipbuilders]] and [[Xizor Transport Systems/Legends|Xizor Transport Systems]].
